q: In July 2026, India signed a defence cooperation agreement that includes uranium exports with which country?
solution: On 9 July 2026, India and **Australia** signed a defence cooperation agreement that includes Australian **uranium exports** to India.
shortcut: Uranium to India 2026 = Australia (Canada is the classic wrong option).

q: The National Dental Commission, set up in March 2026, replaced which body?
solution: The **National Dental Commission** (created 19 March 2026) replaced the **Dental Council of India**, mirroring the 2020 move that replaced MCI with the National Medical Commission.
shortcut: Same playbook as 2020: council → commission, first dentists, then doctors.

q: Which Indian city was chosen to host the 2028 World Athletics Indoor Championships?
solution: **Bhubaneswar** (Odisha) was chosen to host the **2028 World Athletics Indoor Championships** — a first for India at this event.
shortcut: Odisha = athletics host state of choice (Reliance-supported centres, 2028 Indoors).

q: In August 2026, it was announced that ISRO will stop building launch vehicles so that this work moves to —
solution: On 21 August 2026, IN-SPACe chairman **Pawan Goenka** announced that **ISRO will hand launch-vehicle building to the Indian private sector**, with ISRO focusing on deep-space and advanced R&D.
shortcut: Aug 2026 = 'privatise the hard tech' month: ISRO vehicles out, DRDO missile tech shared with industry.

q: The Anti Paper Leak Bill, passed by Parliament in July 2026, primarily targets —
solution: Parliament passed the **Anti Paper Leak Bill, 2026** on 30 July, creating strict penalties for **leaking government recruitment and entrance examination papers** — following the 2024 Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act.
shortcut: 2024 Act covered unfair means; the 2026 Bill tightens the paper-leak provisions.

q: India concluded a Free Trade Agreement with the European Union in January 2026 after negotiations lasting nearly —
solution: The India–EU FTA (announced 27 January 2026) concluded after nearly **18 years** of on-off negotiations that began in 2007 and were revived in 2022.
